title: The Double Deadline
author: A. M. Oyelaran
blurb: Gideon Voss, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
